name: vercel-ai

providers.openai-responses: createOpenAI({ baseURL: WIRETRUTH_BASE_URL_OPENAI_RESPONSES, apiKey })(model); default Responses entry point
providers.ollama: Unsupported: no first-party native Ollama provider; community providers are separate packages.

finish.primary: result.finishReason; fullStream finish-step/finish parts: finishReason, including interrupted mapped to none. NoObjectGeneratedError.finishReason is a documented error field. Error name, message, stack and prototype constructor names select error_map and the library-relative top stack frame. No raw-to-primary inference. https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/reference/ai-sdk-core/stream-text#returns
finish.raw: result.rawFinishReason and fullStream finish-step/finish.rawFinishReason. No private response fields are read.

text.primary: result.text; fullStream text-delta.text concatenated, including deltas before a later error. NoObjectGeneratedError.text is documented generated text.

usage.primary: result.usage; fullStream finish-step.usage; NoObjectGeneratedError.usage. Fields: inputTokens, outputTokens, totalTokens, inputTokenDetails.cacheReadTokens, outputTokenDetails.reasoningTokens. Null/undefined values stay absent; defaults exposed by the SDK are retained.

tool_calls.primary: result.toolCalls and fullStream tool-call parts: toolCallId, toolName, input, invalid, error. Valid input is already parsed by the SDK and is serialized only for arguments_raw; invalid string input is kept verbatim as arguments_raw, with null arguments and parsed=false. Invalid calls retain their error. Tools use tool({ description, inputSchema: jsonSchema(parameters) }) without execute, so no agent continuation runs.

structured.primary: Output.object({ schema: jsonSchema(output_schema) }) with generateText / streamText. result.output is read only after the call/stream completes; a thrown getter is an error, never structured success. No post-error diagnostic side channel is promoted to primary.

stream.primary: result.fullStream; part.type selects text-delta, tool-call, finish-step, finish, error and abort. A finish part with finishReason interrupted sets completed=false; other finish parts set true unless an error or abort part already set false. finish-step records finish and usage without asserting completion; EOF alone leaves null. Yielded errors are outcome=returned with error filled. chunks_seen counts public parts, not HTTP frames. https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/reference/ai-sdk-core/stream-text#returns

error_map.note: Documented finishReason === length is the truncation signal; the shim reports it on primary. https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/reference/ai-sdk-errors/ai-no-object-generated-error

unsupported.reason: The SDK has no first-party native Ollama provider; community providers are separate packages outside this shim.

On claude-haiku-4-5 (and claude-sonnet-5-5) the default structured output is native output_config.format, not a forced tool. The documented jsonTool opt-in forces a tool named json, so no supported path sends the fixture's forced structured_output call.

config_notes: maxRetries and all SDK retry defaults are unchanged. A documented provider fetch callback delegates to the global fetch unchanged and counts model HTTP requests for retry notes. Tools have no execute callback and use the default single-step stopping behavior. Logs remain on stderr.
Scenario reasoning.effort maps to the documented unified reasoning option. Null reasoning leaves the provider default untouched. https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/ai-sdk-core/reasoning

Structured output uses each provider default: OpenAI Chat response_format.json_schema; Responses text.format.json_schema; Anthropic output_config.format for both claude-haiku-4-5 and claude-sonnet-5-5; Gemini generationConfig.responseJsonSchema with responseMimeType application/json. https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/ai-sdk-core/generating-structured-data

OpenAI-compatible defaults to response_format.json_object (supportsStructuredOutputs=false). For the Ollama-compatible schema fixture, the documented supportsStructuredOutputs=true opts into response_format.json_schema. includeUsage is set only from the scenario include_usage hint. https://ai-sdk.dev/providers/openai-compatible-providers

Anthropic structuredOutputMode=jsonTool uses the fixed special tool name json; it cannot select the fixture named structured_output. The forced-tool structured parser scenario is unsupported. Sonnet 5.5 also replaces jsonTool with outputFormat and downgrades required tool choice to auto with a warning. No thinking field is sent without an explicit reasoning/thinking option. https://ai-sdk.dev/providers/ai-sdk-providers/anthropic

Anthropic scenario cache/eager_input_streaming hints map to documented cacheControl and tool providerOptions.anthropic.eagerInputStreaming. Default tool streaming and all other provider defaults are retained. https://ai-sdk.dev/providers/ai-sdk-providers/anthropic

Unknown wire finish values normalize to other on all supported APIs in these pins; rawFinishReason retains the provider string unchanged. The public v7 FinishReason union is stop | length | content-filter | tool-calls | error | interrupted | other, with no unknown member. Clean EOF without a provider completion signal reports interrupted on OpenAI Chat, Responses, Anthropic and Google; OpenAI-compatible retains its missing-finish error. https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/reference/ai-sdk-core/stream-text#returns

System messages map to the documented instructions array; the remaining messages preserve their roles and order. The current core API rejects system roles in messages by default. https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/reference/ai-sdk-core/generate-text
